comparison.advantage_sign: Positive favours private sale; negative favours trade-in. Path-specific replacement prices and fees are included.

policy.method: Deterministic calculator plus hand-authored preference rules.
policy.net_proceeds_formula: Gross offer - disposal fees - current loan settlement
policy.cash_difference_formula: Replacement price + replacement fees - net proceeds
policy.sign_convention: Positive cash difference requires additional cash; negative means a cash surplus.
policy.fee_scope: Each quoted fee must include the full applicable fee total and be explicitly confirmed complete. Do not double count a fee or loan settlement.

limitations: All prices are user-provided quotes/scenarios; private-sale proceeds are not guaranteed.
Completion days and effort hours are user-provided estimates, not measured dealer service guarantees.

asking_price_context.note: Only the unadjusted asking-price reference is used. An illustrative adjustment is never treated as validated market evidence.

time_comparison.basis: User-provided estimates; unknown estimates remain unassessed.
